display_long_description:
Medical Simulator VR is a Virtual Reality-based medical training solution specifically designed for healthcare professionals, residents, and midwifery or nursing students. This simulation delivers an immersive experience in managing childbirth procedures in real-time with high clinical accuracy.
Through VR technology, users can practice motor skills, clinical decision-making, and labor complication management within a safe and controlled environment. This tool aims to reduce the risk of medical errors and enhance the preparedness of practitioners in real-world delivery rooms.
CONTENT WARNING (18+):
This simulation contains explicit medical content, including graphic representations of human reproductive anatomy and realistic childbirth processes. This content is intended solely for medical education and professional training purposes.
Important Note:
This application is an educational tool and does not constitute medical advice for the general public. All procedures displayed are based on standard medical operating protocols and are intended for use under the supervision of qualified instructors or as part of a healthcare education curriculum.
